Definition
[Homotopy of maps of pairs; based homotopy equivalence]

↗ def:homotopy

\group Fundamental Group

A homotopy of pairs carries the first subspace into the second at every time. It is based when it fixes the basepoint. A based homotopy equivalence consists of mutually inverse based maps up to based homotopy.
